subject: general
question: What does the idiom 'Bite the bullet' mean?

options.text: Face a difficult situation with courage
Give someone a piece of advice

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Bite the bullet"** means to face a difficult situation with courage. (कठिन स्थिति का साहस के साथ सामना करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite his fear of the dentist, John decided to **bite the bullet **and make an appointment.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Enjoy a delicious meal** (स्वादिष्ट भोजन का आनंद लेना)

 
 
• **Example: **We decided to enjoy a delicious meal at the new Italian restaurant.
 
 
 
• **Avoid confrontation** (टकराव से बचना)
 
 
• **Example: **She tends to avoid confrontation by not engaging in arguments.
 
 
 
• **Give someone a piece of advice** (किसी को सलाह देना)
 
 
• **Example: **My mentor gave me a piece of advice on how to manage my time better.
